title: The passive with ser: what was created and dissolved

sections.content: You know the passive with *ser* + past participle from B1 Unit 18: *La ley fue aprobada por el Parlamento*. It puts the result in front, and it fits the history of new states, where the important thing is what was created, dissolved or defeated. The participle agrees with the subject: *creada*, *disuelta*, *derrotados*.

items.spanish: La Gran Colombia fue creada en 1819.
items.english: The Gran Colombia was created in 1819.

items.spanish: La federación centroamericana fue disuelta entre 1838 y 1841.
items.english: The Central American federation was dissolved between 1838 and 1841.

items.spanish: La Confederación Perú-Boliviana fue derrotada en 1839.
items.english: The Peru–Bolivian Confederation was defeated in 1839.

items.spanish: Las primeras constituciones fueron escritas por congresos de cada país.
items.english: The first constitutions were written by the congresses of each country.

sections.content: Use *fue* with a singular subject and *fueron* with a plural one, and make the participle agree (*fue disuelta*, *fueron disueltos*). Add *por* + the agent when you want to name who did it; leave it out when it does not matter.
